title: MongoDB launches Atlas Agent Engine for production AI
key_facts: MongoDB launched Atlas Agent Engine, in public preview, for customers already using MongoDB Atlas.
It combines execution, memory and governance in a single layer for running AI agents in production.
It launches alongside MongoDB 9.0 and Atlas Infinite and uses Voyage AI models for embeddings and retrieval.
Pricing is consumption-based for Atlas Agent Runtime and Atlas Agent Memory.
It logs actions against human or software identities and applies policy controls through one control plane.
It supports open standards including MCP and A2A and can run across clouds and self-managed setups.
Early users or evaluators named include Lendi Group and Paysafe; MongoDB says it has more than 70,000 customers.
quote_evidence: MongoDB has launched Atlas Agent Engine, a product for deploying AI agents in production.
The platform logs actions against identities, whether human or software-based, and applies policy controls through a single control plane.
why_it_matters_hint: Companies want a single governed place to run AI agents rather than stitching together separate tools.
notes: Launch article draws on company statements; early users say they are evaluating, not running in production.
